rounds.description: Portfolio value becomes the primary focus; no fabricated returns.
Portfolio, market, alerts and AI each appear once with dedicated styling.
Risk labels and CTA direction depend on existing confirmation state.
Static layout rendered at 320, 360, 412, 768 and 1280 px.
Focus, reduced motion, PT/EN/ES, JS syntax, Vercel and cache verified.

limits: Visual review used an isolated local preview because Chromium blocks navigation to localhost and file URLs.
Full application integrations, live market sources, PRO payments and Android push notifications were not tested in production.
